cap: A pair of over-ear headphones displayed on a sleek headphone stand. The headphones rest on a horizontal support bar attached to a vertical black stand, with the ear cups positioned on either side and the headband arching over the top. The headphones feature white cushioned ear pads and headband with light tan adjustable arms, while the stand has a glossy black finish with a purple glowing Corsair logo in the center and a subtle purple light along the base edge.

A cartoonish green ghost-like character with raised arms. The character has an oval-shaped body with two long, bent arms extending outwards from its sides, ending in simple rounded fists, and a face positioned at the front of the body. The face features two large, glowing white oval eyes and a wide, toothy smile, while the body and arms are smooth and shiny with a bright lime-green color.

A futuristic humanoid robot with a sleek, stylized design. The robot has a rounded helmet-like head with a face partially covered by a mask, glowing turquoise eyes, shoulder joints connected to slender arms, and a torso with a luminous Y-shaped emblem at the chest. The helmet and body armor are primarily glossy white with turquoise accents, the eyes are composed of a glowing hexagonal grid pattern, the chest emblem emits a bright cyan glow, and the joints and inner mechanical parts are matte black, giving it a high-tech, polished appearance.

A medieval-style street lamp mounted on a wooden post. The structure consists of a tall, slightly irregular wooden beam fixed into a stone base, with a horizontal wooden arm extending outward to support a hanging lantern. The wooden post has a rough, chiseled texture in a muted brown color, the stone base is grey with a speckled, weathered texture, and the lantern has a metallic frame with warm yellow glowing glass panels and a pointed top and bottom.

A carved Halloween pumpkin jack-o'-lantern. The pumpkin has a short brown stem on top, two round eye holes, a triangular nose in the center, and a jagged, wide mouth at the bottom, all cutouts allowing internal light to shine through. The surface of the pumpkin is bright orange with a smooth texture, the stem is dark brown with a natural wood grain pattern, and the internal light gives a warm yellowish glow that enhances the carved facial features against the black background.

A futuristic sci-fi weapon with an organic, insect-like design. The weapon features a sleek green outer shell with angular armor plates surrounding a central glowing yellow energy core, various exposed mechanical components at the center, and several flexible black cable-like appendages extending from the bottom and rear. The green armor has a matte, slightly worn texture with small engraved markings, the yellow core emits a bright neon glow with transparent casing showing internal machinery, the metallic center houses detailed panels with buttons and small colored indicators, and the segmented black cables are smooth with subtle futuristic markings on their surfaces.

A pair of ornate wall-mounted light fixtures. Each fixture has three upward-facing frosted glass lampshades attached to golden, intricately curved metal arms, with decorative golden spheres positioned centrally. The lampshades emit a bright white glow, the metal arms have an elegant scrollwork design with a polished gold finish, and the golden spheres feature a smooth, glossy texture enhancing the overall luxurious aesthetic.

A beverage vending machine with a large promotional display. The front features a left panel with an image of a drink being poured over ice above a wide dispensing slot labeled "FROSTY," and a right panel containing a payment system, product selection buttons arranged vertically, and a coin slot near the bottom. The promotional image shows amber-colored liquid splashing over detailed translucent ice cubes against a frosty blue background, the selection buttons have colored labels with small text indicating drink names, the black payment section includes a digital display and card reader with a yellow-lit icon, and the machine casing is matte black.

A handheld Nintendo Switch gaming console with neon Joy-Con controllers. The device has a central rectangular screen flanked by a blue Joy-Con on the left and a red Joy-Con on the right, each featuring buttons and control sticks positioned for gameplay. The screen displays the console’s home menu with icons for various functions like News, eShop, Album, and Settings, along with game tiles including "Super Smash Bros. Ultimate" and "Mario Kart 8 Deluxe"; the Joy-Cons have a smooth, glossy texture and the buttons are matte black with a rounded design.

A fantasy-themed magical war hammer with glowing crystal elements. The hammer has a large, faceted pink crystal head set in a metallic holder on one end, a smaller pink crystal on the opposite end, and a central black shaft wrapped with glowing blue bands and adorned with small hanging claw-like ornaments. The large crystal head is vividly pink and semi-transparent with sharp edges, the metallic holder is dark with copper-golden accents, the shaft has a smooth black finish with teal glowing sections, and the decorations include tiny pink shards floating above the handle and crescent-shaped claws in a polished golden-beige tone.

A sinister Halloween-themed animatronic character. The figure has a humanoid form with a menacing jack-o'-lantern face, glowing orange cracks throughout its dark body, and holds a carved pumpkin with a glowing face in its right hand. The animatronic's body is ragged and torn with jagged edges, the glowing orange light seeps from within its hollow structure, the pumpkin it holds has triangular eyes and a sharp-toothed grin, and the overall color scheme is a matte black surface contrasted by the bright, fiery orange glow.

A stylized arrangement of three lit candles in a round holder. The candles are positioned closely together inside the holder, with one tall candle in the back and two shorter ones in the front at slightly different heights. Each candle is a warm golden-yellow color with a glowing flame at the wick, wax drips down the sides in smooth stylized shapes, and the holder is a faceted, deep brown bowl with a subtle gradient from dark at the base to lighter at the rim.
